Rachel H (UK Small & Medium Business Team Manager @ NielsenIQ | Helping Small & Medium Businesses Grow by leveraging the power of data | Challenger Brand Champion!)
See you in London on 17 June?
 
I'll be at the Food & Drink Exporters Association (FDEA) 35x35 Summer Export Conference - one of the most exciting days in the UK food and drink export calendar!

📍 Royal Geographical Society
👥 ~400 industry leaders
🎯 A shared ambition: driving British exports to £35 billion by 2035
 
You can find me in the Export Education Centre representing NielsenIQ with other Food & Drink Exporters Association (FDEA) Approved Partners!

Whether you’re looking to:
👉 chat about what you’re working on
👉 exchange ideas and insights
👉 or simply put a face to a name

👋  Come and say hello — I’d love to connect!

Attending too? Let’s get ahead of the crowd: 💬 Join the conversation via the FDEA Collaborative: collaborative.fdea.org.uk

📩 Or drop me a message here — always happy to connect before the day.

⬇️ Link to grab the last few tickets in the comments below ⬇️ 

#FoodAndDrink #Exports #Networking #UKBusiness #FDEA #35x35
